en.quote: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
en.riddle: Art thou greatly angry for the gourd?
en.speaker: God said to Jonah

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל-יוֹנָה הַהֵיטֵב חָרָה-לְךָ עַל-הַקִּיקָיוֹן וַיֹּאמֶר הֵיטֵב חָֽרָה-לִי עַד-מָֽוֶת
he.speaker: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל-יוֹנָה
